entries.notes: Registrant entity appears in RDAP as 'Contact Privacy Inc. Customer [N]' where N is a per-domain unique customer number. entries.notes: Admitted by DATA-Q3 resolution (2026-06-20): geographic relevance (low UK-sector cohort prevalence) is not a valid PSD-001 admission criterion. Admission decisions are governed exclusively by §5 and §6. Normalised via iterative Step 5 (Amendment C7): 'PrivacyCo Pty Ltd' → remove 'ltd' → 'PrivacyCo Pty' → remove 'pty' → 'privacyco'.
